lessons.titleEn: a brilliant servant, but a poor master
lessons.titleZh: 出色的僕人，拙劣的主人

brief.meaningEn: Money or a tool can help when people direct it, but can harm when allowed to govern their choices.
brief.meaningZh: 金錢或工具受人主導時可以幫上忙；若反過來支配人的選擇，便可能帶來傷害。
brief.grammar: Pattern: X is/can be a good or brilliant servant, but a poor master. The source uses good with money; the original lesson uses brilliant with technology. Keep the two count-noun complements and their articles; X names the resource or tool being directed.
brief.register: Reflective advice about control: a person may value money or a tool for what it enables while resisting its power to dictate priorities. In the original technology case, a community organiser advises a fellow volunteer to check a translation-app draft.
brief.boundaryZh: 此比喻可用於金錢或工具：有用不等於應讓它支配家庭生活或判斷；不是說金錢或機器真的變成僕人或主人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把賺錢、儲蓄或使用工具本身當成錯；關鍵是人是否仍按真正需要作出選擇。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說出金錢或工具如何幫助人，以及它何時開始不恰當地主導人的選擇。

sources.sentence: My grandfather believed money is a good servant, but a poor master in family life.
sources.expression: money is a good servant, but a poor master

listening.en: A budgeting app helped Noor spot waste, but its strict limits made her skip necessary groceries. She revised them around her needs: the app was a brilliant servant, but a poor master.
listening.zh: 理財程式幫娜兒發現浪費，但程式建議的嚴格限額令她連必需食材也不買。她按自己的需要調整限額：程式是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人。
listening.promptZh: 這句話在娜兒使用理財程式時指甚麼？

options.en: The app helped her spot waste, but its suggested limits should not override her essential needs.
options.zh: 程式幫她找出浪費，但建議的限額不應凌駕她的基本需要。

options.en: The suggested limits were helpful, so she should keep them even when they leave no money for necessary groceries.
options.zh: 建議限額既然有用，即使令她無錢買必需食材，也應照用。

options.en: Because one limit was unsuitable, the spending information the app provides has no value.
options.zh: 有一項限額不合適，便表示程式提供的開支資料毫無價值。

options.en: The main problem was that Noor bought groceries before reviewing the app’s spending categories.
options.zh: 主要問題是娜兒在檢視程式的開支分類前買了食材。

listening.explanationZh: 程式指出浪費有幫助，但她曾盲從建議限額，犧牲基本需要；調整限額表示她重新掌握決定權。

reply.promptEn: How should we use a homework planning app without letting it decide our whole week?
reply.promptZh: （我們應如何使用功課規劃程式，同時不讓它決定整個星期？）

options.en: Use its reminders, but choose our own priorities and rest times.
options.zh: 使用提醒功能，但自行決定優先次序與休息時間。

options.en: Review its suggestions before moving family or study plans.
options.zh: 更改家庭或溫習計劃前，先檢視它的建議。

options.en: It can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master; let it remind us without obeying every suggestion.
options.zh: 它可以是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人；讓它提醒我們，卻不用盲從每項建議。

options.en: Keep a way to adjust the schedule when our needs change.
options.zh: 需要改變時，保留自行調整時間表的方法。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出既利用工具又保留自主決定的做法；金句以僕人與主人比喻概括界線。

options.en: Money can be a good servant, but a poor master: paying off debt helped, yet chasing a higher balance need not dictate every family hour.
options.zh: 金錢可以是好僕人，卻是差主人：還清債務有幫助，但追求更高存款不必支配每段家庭時間。

options.en: The extra shifts paid off debt, so the lost family time cannot be a cost.
options.zh: 加班還清了債，所以失去的家庭時間不可能是代價。

options.en: The lost family time proves that earning money to repay the debt was never useful.
options.zh: 失去家庭時間證明賺錢還債從來沒有用處。

scene.explanationZh: 加班還債有實際幫助；若只為增加存款便放棄所有相聚時間，金錢就開始反過來支配生活。另兩項各忽略了一面。
scene.promptZh: 麗娜多接班還清了債，現在卻為了讓存款數字繼續上升，連每週與家人吃飯的時間也全數放棄。哪句評語最能同時看到金錢的幫助和它對生活的支配？

options.en: A student uses an app’s reminder but chooses when to take a break.
options.zh: 學生使用程式提醒，仍自行決定何時休息。

options.en: A device schedules every meal and refuses changes even when family plans shift.
options.zh: 裝置安排每餐時間，即使家庭計劃改變也不容修改。

options.en: A recommendation system keeps pushing choices even after users reject them.
options.zh: 推薦系統在使用者拒絕後仍不斷推送選項。

contrast.explanationZh: 學生仍自己決定，工具只是協助，未出現反客為主；另外兩項限制或無視使用者選擇。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 a brilliant servant, but a poor master 警告工具反客為主？

options.en: It can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master; use the light correction, but decide yourself which details belong in the picture.
options.zh: 它可以是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人；可用它調光，但照片該保留甚麼細節，仍要自己決定。

options.en: The light correction helped, so its cropping suggestion must also preserve the picture’s meaning.
options.zh: 調光既然有幫助，裁剪建議也必定能保留照片的原意。

options.en: Because one crop was misleading, the tool cannot help with any part of the editing.
options.zh: 一次裁剪造成誤導，這工具便不能協助任何修圖工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 調光功能有用，但裁剪會改變照片意思時，使用者須自行判斷是否接受；另外兩項都把局部經驗推得太遠。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「修圖工具幫我調亮照片很方便；但我照着它的建議刪掉重要背景，照片的意思也變了。」你如何回應較貼切？

speaking.en: A navigation app can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master if drivers follow it past a clear road-closure sign.
speaking.zh: 導航程式能提供協助；但若司機無視清楚的封路路牌而盲從它，程式便由出色的僕人變成拙劣的主人。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出司機應在哪裏自行判斷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校報編輯用寫作工具修正文法，節省校對時間；工具卻建議刪去受訪者一段重要引述。編輯檢查建議後保留引述，自行決定文章重點。用一至兩句英文說明這個平衡。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出工具修正文法的幫助、刪去重要引述的問題，以及編輯核對建議並保留引述的自主決定；不要把工具說成全無用處。

examples.en: The editing tool can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master: it corrected grammar, yet the school editors kept an important quote after reviewing its suggestion.
examples.zh: 編輯工具可以是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人：它修正文法，但校報編輯核對建議後，仍保留一段重要引述。

examples.en: The school editors used software to fix grammar, but rejected its suggestion to remove an important quote; they showed that it can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master when allowed to decide what matters.
examples.zh: 校報編輯用軟件修正文法，卻拒絕它刪去重要引述的建議；他們表明，工具若獲准決定文章重點，就可能由出色的僕人變成拙劣的主人。

takeaways.en: As a tool, technology is a brilliant servant, but a poor master if it replaces a person’s judgment.
takeaways.zh: 科技可成為出色的僕人，但若取代人的判斷，便是拙劣的主人。

takeaways.en: Money can be a good servant, but a poor master when saving begins to crowd out time with family.
takeaways.zh: 儲蓄若開始擠掉與家人相處的時間，金錢便可能由好僕人變成差主人。
